Strategic Growth, Business & Research Consultant with over 10 years of professional experience (since 2015).
Based in Cirebon and Jakarta, Indonesia.

## Core Capabilities & 4 Solution Pillars

1. Executive Business Proposals & Pitch Decks
   - Commercial partnership proposals, investor pitch decks, feasibility studies, and operational supply chain workflows.
   - Grounded in transparent financial projections (5-year cash flows) and executive visual presentation.

2. SEO & High-Conversion Content Growth
   - Commercial intent keyword discovery, competitor analysis, on-page technical health, and conversion copywriting.
   - Proven track record: 3rd Place National WOM Finance SEO Contest, Top 3 Google SERP ranking jump, and +140% B2B lead generation.

3. Academic Research & Statistical Data Analysis
   - Empirical quantitative data analysis, SPSS and Python statistical modeling (validity, reliability, regression, hypothesis testing).
   - Structured guidance for national SINTA accredited journal manuscripts (SINTA 2 to SINTA 4) through peer-review acceptance.

4. High-Performance Web Solutions (Tech-Agnostic)
   - Mobile-speed optimization, clean responsive layouts, and 100% accessibility compliance (A11y).
   - Adaptable to client infrastructure (WordPress, Webflow, custom Next.js/Tailwind, or Cloudflare Edge).
